claims.text: The provided sources contain no termination-for-convenience right for either party. The only termination mechanisms shown are non-renewal at the end of a term, automatic termination if no fee agreement is reached before a Renewal Term, and termination for uncured breach. These sources are excerpts, so the full agreement should be checked to confirm.

citations.quote: Either party hereto shall have the right to terminate this Agreement in the event of a breach by the other party of its obligations hereunder

claims.text: Either party may decline to renew. The Agreement starts with a 3-year Initial Term and renews automatically for one-year Renewal Terms unless a party gives written notice 30 days before expiration, at which point it terminates. This is a right to exit at the end of a term, not a mid-term termination for convenience.

citations.quote: unless either Charterer or Owner elects not to renew this Agreement by providing the other party with written notice of such election 30 days prior to the expiration of the Initial Term or Renewal Term, as applicable, at which point this Agreement will automatically terminate.
The initial term of this Agreement shall be for 3 years

claims.text: Either party may terminate for breach. The non-breaching party must give 10 days prior written notice and the breaching party has an opportunity to cure during that period.

citations.quote: subject to 10 days prior written notice of such breach given by the non-breaching party to the breaching party and the opportunity for such breaching party to cure such breach during such 10 day period.

claims.text: If the parties do not agree on a renegotiated fee by the start of a Renewal Term, the Agreement terminates automatically. This is tied to fee renegotiation, not convenience.

citations.quote: If no such agreement on such fee is reached by such parties by the commencement of a Renewal Term, this Agreement shall automatically terminate.
